subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should OpenClaw treat standalone JSON-shaped assistant content as an executable tool call across every provider using the shared plain-text compatibility wrapper?
rationale: The patch changes the generic fallback contract from recognizing bracket, XML, and Harmony syntax to also executing JSON text, which can change previously visible model output into tool execution and therefore requires explicit ownership of the compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve shared JSON repair
options.body: Accept JSON as another shared fallback format after exact-path live proof confirms promotion, allowlisting, replay, and no-leak behavior.

options.title: Keep repair provider-owned
options.body: Limit the fix to the provider adapter that loses or misroutes native structured tool calls, avoiding a broader executable text format.

options.title: Pause pending native repro
options.body: Hold the PR until a raw Ollama or affected-provider response demonstrates whether the defect is native-field handling or JSON content fallback.

recommendation.title: Approve shared JSON repair
recommendation.body: Accept JSON as another shared fallback format after exact-path live proof confirms promotion, allowlisting, replay, and no-leak behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and review routing connect this person most strongly to the shared repair package and its compatibility policy.
